blocker.summary: Lens Studio 5.23.2 project-scope TypeScript compilation never runs in this environment, so scripts do not execute in Preview ('Preview not ready ... TypeScript is not compiled'). Not a code problem: the five project scripts compile with 0 errors.
preciseFindings: RecompileTypeScriptTool and ITypeScriptCompilationApi.refreshProjectCompilation both hang indefinitely (no lensifyts process ever launched, no log output) whenever the loaded project actually contains TypeScriptAssets; they return 'TypeScript compiler is not configured (no TypeScript files in project)' instantly whenever it does not
tsc-only pipeline itself is healthy: runIsolatedCompilation compiles arbitrary sources (used to verify our code), and the editor's own __execute__.ts staging compiles with real diagnostics

the failure mode is instance-state-dependent, not config-dependent: reproduced across 4 app relaunches, with Assets/tsconfig.json + root tsconfig.json corrected to the official documented shape (TS5-native decorators — the project's Decorators.d.ts declares ClassDecoratorContext signatures, so experimentalDecorators must stay OFF), stale project locks removed, scripts wired into ScriptComponents, sign-in ok, Spectacles target

physical display is LOCKED (screencapture returns a fully black frame) and osascript keystrokes are not permitted (System Events error 1002) — matches the prior session receipt's headless-environment suspicion; the compile manager's preparation phase appears to require UI/screen session context that never completes here

one launch landed on a temp Default project instead of the target (open -a race) — that instance legitimately reported 'no TypeScript files in project'; MCP openProject then loaded the real project correctly (30.76s, 1199 files, 540 TypeScriptAsset imports)
